definition_zh: 明天；明日；未来；不久之后
definition_en: the day after today, or the future time that is coming
core_image: 太阳落下的另一边：今天还没到的那一天
scene: 小明把作业忘在学校，他对妈妈说：I will finish my homework tomorrow after school.
sceneCN: 这里 tomorrow 是「明天」（第 1 个义项：今天之后的那一天）；句意是他打算在第二天放学后完成作业。

collocations.zh: 更美好的明天；更好的未来

derivatives.zh: 由 tomorrow 加所有格构成，义为「明天的；未来的」
由 tomorrow 加复数构成，义为「未来的日子；往后的岁月」

senses.title: The day after today
senses.titleCN: 明天；今天之后的那一天
senses.definition: the day that comes directly after today
senses.definitionCN: 紧接在今天之后的那一天
senses.example: We are leaving for Shanghai tomorrow.
senses.exampleCN: 我们明天动身去上海。
senses.why: The core image is the other side of today's sunset, so tomorrow naturally names the next day.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是今天日落之后的另一边，所以 tomorrow 自然指代接下来的一天。

senses.title: The near future
senses.definition: the future, especially the near future that people hope for or worry about
senses.definitionCN: 未来，尤指人们盼望或担忧的近未来
senses.example: Tomorrow belongs to the young people who study hard today.
senses.exampleCN: 未来属于今天努力学习年轻人。
senses.why: From the concrete next day, the meaning extends to all the days still to come.
senses.whyCN: 从具体的一天延伸到所有尚未到来的日子，引申为未来。

senses.title: An indefinite later time
senses.definition: a later time that is not fixed, often used to postpone something
senses.definitionCN: 尚未确定的稍后时间，常用于推迟某事
senses.example: Never put off what you can do today until tomorrow.
senses.exampleCN: 不要把今天能做的事拖到明天。
senses.why: Because tomorrow always stays one day away, it can stand for any postponed time.
senses.whyCN: 因为明天永远比今天晚一天，所以它可以代表任何被推迟的时间。

intro.en: Tomorrow is a native English compound built from Old English elements meaning 'to' and 'morning'.
intro.cn: tomorrow 是英语本土复合词，由古英语「到」与「早晨」两个成分构成。

items.en: The verb to-mæran meant 'to happen at morn', from to (to) + mærgen (morning).
items.cn: 古英语 to-mæran 意为「在早晨发生」，由 to（到）加 mærgen（早晨）构成。

items.en: It developed into to-morwe and to-morrow, meaning 'on the morrow, the next day'.
items.cn: 中古英语演变为 to-morwe 与 to-morrow，意为「次日，第二天」。

items.en: Spelling settled as tomorrow, replacing the older form morrow in daily use.
items.cn: 拼写定型为 tomorrow，日常用法中逐渐取代旧的 morrow。

items.en: The extended sense 'the future' became common in speech and writing.
items.cn: 「未来」这一引申义在口语和书面语中普遍使用。

items.en: The origin is clear; only the exact date when the extended sense spread is uncertain.
items.cn: 词源本身清楚，只是引申义普及的确切年代不确定。

note.en: Words that look or sound close to tomorrow, and words in the same time field.
note.cn: 与 tomorrow 形近音近的词，以及同属时间义场的词。

entries.definitionCN: 次日；早晨（文学用语），与 tomorrow 同源，只是去掉了前缀 to

entries.definition: a person who keeps postponing things until tomorrow (rare, humorous)
entries.definitionCN: 总把事情拖到明天的人（罕见、戏谑用法）

entries.definition: the early part of the day
entries.definitionCN: 早晨；上午，与 tomorrow 的核心成分 mærgen 同源

entries.definition: the time that will come after now
entries.definitionCN: 未来；将来，范围比 tomorrow 更广，不限于第二天
今天；今日，与 tomorrow 相对照的时间词
昨天；昨日，与 tomorrow 构成过去与未来的对照

entries.definition: in a short time from now
entries.definitionCN: 不久；很快，指临近的时间但不具体到某一天

normalIntro.en: Break the word into to + mor(row) and link each part to a real picture.
normalIntro.cn: 把单词拆成 to + mor(row)，每一部分都对应一个真实画面。

normal.en: to + morrow = moving forward to the next morning
normal.cn: to（到）+ morrow（早晨）＝走向下一个早晨，就是明天

normal.en: morrow shares the root with morning
normal.cn: morrow 与 morning 同源，都来自古英语「早晨」

normal.en: collocation: see you tomorrow
normal.cn: 常用搭配 see you tomorrow（明天见），告别时最常说的话

normal.en: the day after tomorrow = two days later
normal.cn: the day after tomorrow（后天）＝明天的明天

normal.en: Tomorrow is a compound, not a borrowed word
normal.cn: tomorrow 是本土复合词，不是外来词，词根就藏在词形里

abstract.en: Picture the sun setting: the other side of tonight is tomorrow
abstract.cn: 想象太阳落山：今晚的另一边就是明天

abstract.en: Tomorrow is a bridge you walk toward but never stand on until it becomes today
abstract.cn: 明天是一座你不断走近、只有变成今天才踩得到的桥

abstract.en: Hear 'to-morrow' as 'toward morning'
abstract.cn: 把 to-morrow 听成「朝早晨走去」，画面感即成记忆

examples.en: I will call you tomorrow morning.
examples.cn: 我明天早上给你打电话。

examples.en: Science today shapes the world of tomorrow.
examples.cn: 今天的科学塑造着明天的世界。

examples.en: Their tomorrows were full of hope after the war ended.
examples.cn: 战争结束后，他们的未来充满希望。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吐毛肉」——想象明天一早要去理发店吐掉嘴里的毛发碎肉？荒诞画面只为锁住拼写：to-mor-row 三段式，别写成 tommorrow。

root: 本土复合词：古英语 to（到）+ mærgen（早晨），本义「在早晨到来时」，即「次日」。morrow 与 morning 同根，均出自日耳曼语族的「早晨」一词。

sensesIntro.en: From the concrete next day, the meaning widens to the future and to any postponed time.
sensesIntro.cn: 从具体的「明天」扩展到抽象的「未来」，再到任何被推迟的时间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the other side of tonight's sunset
core.cn: 核心意象：今晚日落之后的另一边

branches.cn: 具体的一天：今天之后的第二天

branches.en: the future we hope for or plan for
branches.cn: 我们盼望或规划的未来

branches.en: any time we push things off to
branches.cn: 我们把事情推向的任何延后时间
在盼望与拖延之间：同一个词的两面

branches.en: from one sunrise to all sunrises to come
branches.cn: 从一次日出延伸到未来所有的日出

intro.en: Tomorrow is a compound of two native Old English words, so it has no classical prefix or suffix.
intro.cn: tomorrow 由两个古英语本土词复合而成，没有古典前缀或后缀。

latinIntro.en: As a Germanic compound, tomorrow has no Latin relatives in this word family.
latinIntro.cn: 作为日耳曼复合词，tomorrow 在词源上没有拉丁同族词。

on the morrow means on the next day
items.exampleCN: on the morrow 意为「第二天」

items.meaning: the early part of the day

definition_en: a unit of weight equal to 1,000 kilograms or a very large amount
core_image: 压秤的大铁块：一整吨沉甸甸的重量
scene: 仓库管理员看着进货单说：The truck delivered ten tons of steel today.
sceneCN: 这里 ton 是「吨」（第 1 个义项：重量单位）；句意是卡车今天运来了十吨钢材。

derivatives.zh: 由 ton 加名词后缀 -age 构成，义为「吨位；载重量」
公吨的英式拼法，与 ton 同源而用法有别

senses.title: A unit of weight
senses.definition: a unit for measuring weight, equal to 1,000 kilograms (metric ton) or 2,240 pounds (long ton)
senses.definitionCN: 计量重量的单位，公吨合一千公斤，长吨合两千二百四十磅
senses.example: The bridge can carry trucks up to forty tons.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥能承载四十吨以内的卡车。
senses.why: The core image of a huge heavy block is literally what the unit measures.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象的巨大重块正是这个单位所度量的东西。

senses.title: A very large amount
senses.definition: an informal way to say a very large quantity of something
senses.definitionCN: 口语中表示数量极多的说法
senses.example: Thanks a ton for helping me move house.
senses.exampleCN: 非常感谢你帮我搬家。
senses.why: Anything weighing a ton is enormous, so the unit became a hyperbole for plenty.
senses.whyCN: 重达一吨的东西必然极多，于是计量单位被夸张成「大量」。

intro.en: Ton comes from a Germanic word for a large cask, later fixed as a unit of weight.
intro.cn: ton 来自日耳曼语中指大酒桶的词，后来固定为重量单位。

items.en: Tunne meant a large cask or barrel for wine or beer.
items.cn: 古英语 tunne 指装酒的大桶。

items.en: The weight of a full cask of wine became a standard measure of about two thousand pounds.
items.cn: 中世纪英语中，一满桶酒的重量约两千磅，成为标准计量。

items.en: Ton was fixed as the unit of weight, spelled ton or tun.
items.cn: 十五世纪，ton 定型为重量单位，拼作 ton 或 tun。

items.en: The informal sense 'a lot' spread in everyday speech.
items.cn: 现代英语中「大量」的口语义普及开来。

items.en: The cask origin is generally accepted; early spelling varied widely.
items.cn: 「酒桶」来源一般被接受，早期拼写在历史上多有变化。

note.en: Words close to ton in spelling or sound, and words in the weight-and-quantity field.
note.cn: 与 ton 拼写或发音相近的词，以及同属重量与数量义场的词。

entries.definition: a large cask; an old unit for wine
entries.definitionCN: 大酒桶；旧制葡萄酒计量单位，与 ton 同源同音，只是保留了古拼写

entries.definition: a sound or quality of voice
entries.definitionCN: 音调；语气，只是与 ton 拼写相近，词源完全不同

entries.definition: the organ of taste and speech
entries.definitionCN: 舌头；语言，拼写与 ton 相近但词源无关

entries.definition: the metric ton, one thousand kilograms
entries.definitionCN: 公吨，与 ton 同指千公斤，只是英式区分拼法
磅，更小的重量单位，与 ton 构成度量阶梯

entries.definition: the base metric unit of mass
entries.definitionCN: 千克，公制质量基本单位，一千个千克合一吨

entries.definition: a quantity carried at one time
entries.definitionCN: 载荷；一次搬运的量，与「大量」义相通

entries.definition: a large untidy pile or quantity
entries.definitionCN: 一堆；大量，口语中同样表示极多

normalIntro.en: Anchor the word with its sound, its cask story, and its common phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 用发音、酒桶故事和常用搭配锚定这个词。

normal.en: ton sounds exactly like tun, the old cask
normal.cn: ton 与 tun 同音，tun 就是那只古英语大酒桶

normal.en: a full wine cask once weighed about a ton
normal.cn: 一满桶酒曾经就约重一吨，单位从实物而来

normal.en: tons of = a lot of in everyday speech
normal.cn: tons of 是口语中的「大量」，如 tons of time（大把时间）

normal.en: one metric ton = one thousand kilograms
normal.cn: 一公吨＝一千公斤，记住这个换算

normal.en: tonnage measures ships by tons
normal.cn: tonnage（吨位）用吨来衡量船舶大小

abstract.en: Picture a giant wine barrel slowly sinking a scale
abstract.cn: 想象一只巨大的酒桶把秤盘慢慢压到底

abstract.en: Hear the heavy thud of t-o-n dropping onto the floor
abstract.cn: 听 t-o-n 三个音像重物砸地的闷响

abstract.en: Feel a ton of homework pressing on your desk
abstract.cn: 感受一吨作业压在书桌上的分量，即「大量」义

examples.en: The elephant weighs several tons.
examples.cn: 大象重达数吨。

examples.en: We have tons of time before the train leaves.
examples.cn: 离火车出发还有大把时间。

examples.en: The ship has a tonnage of fifty thousand tons.
examples.cn: 这艘船的吨位是五万吨。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「桶」——ton 的发音就像「桶」，而它的词源恰好真是大酒桶；想象一桶酒重达一吨。

root: 日耳曼语源：古英语 tunne（大酒桶），一般认为源自中世纪拉丁语 tunna（桶），后者又可能借自凯尔特语。一满桶酒的重量演变为重量单位。

sensesIntro.en: A cask that once set a weight standard, now a unit and a byword for plenty.
sensesIntro.cn: 曾以酒桶定标准的计量单位，如今既是吨位又是「大量」的代名词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a giant cask pressing the scale down
core.cn: 核心意象：把秤盘压到底的巨型酒桶

branches.cn: 正式的重量单位：吨
口语里说「一大堆」的夸张说法

branches.en: from real tons to figurative tons
branches.cn: 从真实的吨到夸张的吨：一义两用
借用沉重感造出的夸张表达

branches.en: metric and long tons in trade
branches.cn: 贸易中公吨与长吨的区分

intro.en: Ton is a short borrowed noun with no living prefix or suffix inside it.
intro.cn: ton 是一个简短的借入名词，词内没有活用的前缀或后缀。

latinIntro.en: The likely Latin source tunna leaves few direct relatives in English.
latinIntro.cn: 可能的中世纪拉丁语来源 tunna 在英语中留下的直接同族词不多。

items.meaning: capacity of a ship in tons

items.meaningCN: 滋补品；补药，仅拼写相近，与 ton 无词源关系
时髦的（旧用法，源自法语 à la ton）

definition_en: the quality of a sound or voice, or the general mood and style of something
core_image: 同一句话的不同声调：声音里带着的颜色和态度
scene: 老师对学生的语气感到不满，说道：I don't like the tone of your answer just now.
sceneCN: 这里 tone 是「语气」（第 2 个义项：说话的方式和态度）；句意是老师不喜欢学生刚才回答的语气。

derivatives.zh: 由 tone 加 -ed 构成，义为「有……色调的；肌肉结实的」
由 tone 加 -er 构成，义为「调色剂；爽肤水」
mono-（单一）+ tone，义为「单调的声音」

senses.title: A quality of sound
senses.definition: a sound with a particular pitch or quality, especially of the voice or a musical instrument
senses.definitionCN: 具有特定音高或质感的声音，尤指人声或乐器声
senses.example: The piano has a rich, warm tone.
senses.exampleCN: 这架钢琴音色醇厚温暖。
senses.why: The core image of sound carrying color starts from the raw quality of a single note.
senses.whyCN: 声音自带「颜色」的核心意象，正始于单个音的质感。

senses.title: The manner of speaking
senses.definition: the way someone's voice shows their feelings or attitude when speaking
senses.definitionCN: 说话声音中流露出的情感或态度
senses.example: Her tone made it clear that she was angry.
senses.exampleCN: 她的语气清楚地表明她生气了。
senses.why: The same words in different tones carry different attitudes, so sound quality turns into attitude.
senses.whyCN: 同样的话用不同声调说出来态度各异，于是声音质感引申为态度。

senses.title: A shade of color
senses.definition: a slight variety of a color, or the general effect of colors together
senses.definitionCN: 颜色的细微差异，或整体配色给人的效果
senses.example: The room is painted in soft earth tones.
senses.exampleCN: 房间刷成了柔和的大地色调。
senses.why: Just as sound has tone, color was said to have its own tone, so the word crossed into color.
senses.whyCN: 声音有 tone，颜色也被说成有自己的 tone，一词跨入色彩领域。

senses.title: The general mood or style
senses.definition: the general feeling, mood, or style of a piece of writing, event, or situation
senses.definitionCN: 文章、事件或局面的整体情绪或风格
senses.example: The opening speech set a serious tone for the conference.
senses.exampleCN: 开幕致辞为会议定下了严肃的基调。
senses.why: The overall attitude of a talk is its tone at scale, from one sentence to a whole event.
senses.whyCN: 整场讲话的态度就是放大的语气，从一个句子扩展到整个事件。

senses.title: Firmness of the body
senses.definition: the normal firmness or strength of muscles and tissues
senses.definitionCN: 肌肉和组织的正常紧实度与力量
senses.example: Swimming improves muscle tone.
senses.exampleCN: 游泳能改善肌肉的紧实度。
senses.why: A body in good condition was said to be in good tone, like an instrument in tune.
senses.whyCN: 身体状态好被说成「tone 好」，如同乐器音准良好。

senses.title: To soften or strengthen
senses.definition: to make a color, feeling, or body less strong or more firm
senses.definitionCN: 使颜色、情绪变得柔和，或使身体变得结实
senses.example: You should tone down your criticism.
senses.exampleCN: 你应该缓和一下批评的措辞。
senses.why: Adjusting a tone in music means changing its strength, so the verb means to adjust.
senses.whyCN: 调整乐音就是改变其强度，动词义由此表示「调节」。

intro.en: Tone comes through French from Latin tonus, which itself is from Greek tonos meaning 'a stretching'.
intro.cn: tone 经法语来自拉丁语 tonus，后者又源自希腊语 tonos，本义「拉伸」。

items.en: The root *ten- meant 'to stretch', seen in many English words like extend.
items.cn: 词根 *ten- 意为「拉伸」，与 extend 等许多词同源。

items.en: Tonos meant a stretching, tension, or the pitch of a voice.
items.cn: 希腊语 tonos 意为拉伸、张力，或人声的音高。

items.en: Tonus kept the sense of sound or pitch in learned use.
items.cn: 拉丁语 tonus 保留了声音、音高的含义。

items.en: Ton passed into French with the meaning of sound and voice quality.
items.cn: ton 进入法语，意为声音、嗓音质地。

items.en: Tone entered English for musical sound, then spread to color, mood, and health.
items.cn: 十四世纪 tone 进入英语指乐音，后扩展到色彩、情绪与健康。

note.en: Spelling neighbors of tone, and words sharing the sound-and-mood field.
note.cn: 与 tone 拼写相近的词，以及同属声音与情绪义场的词。

entries.definitionCN: 吨，重量单位，只是与 tone 拼写相近，词源迥异

entries.definition: the organ of speech and taste
entries.definitionCN: 舌头；语言，拼写相近但与 tone 无词源关联
无音调的；缺乏表情的，由 tone 加后缀构成
滋补的；补药，与 tone 同出希腊词根「拉伸」

entries.definition: how high or low a sound is
entries.definitionCN: 音高，指声音的高低，tone 更强调音的质感

entries.definition: the feeling of a place or time
entries.definitionCN: 情绪；氛围，与 tone 的「基调」义相近

entries.definition: a slight variety of a color
entries.definitionCN: 色度；深浅层次，与 tone 的「色调」义重叠
口音；重音，同样属于说话方式

normalIntro.en: Use the Greek stretch root and everyday phrases to fix the word.
normalIntro.cn: 用希腊「拉伸」词根和日常搭配来固定这个词。

normal.en: tone shares the root ten- (stretch) with extend
normal.cn: tone 与 extend 同出词根 ten-（拉伸），声音是被「拉紧」发出的

normal.en: set the tone = decide the general feeling
normal.cn: set the tone（定基调）是开场、开篇的常用说法

normal.en: tone down = make it softer
normal.cn: tone down（缓和）常用于批评、色彩、新闻措辞

normal.en: muscle tone = how firm your muscles are
normal.cn: muscle tone 指肌肉紧实度，健身语境常见

normal.en: skin tone = the color of your skin
normal.cn: skin tone 指肤色，化妆品语境高频词

abstract.en: Hear one violin note glowing with its own color
abstract.cn: 听小提琴的一个音泛出它独有的颜色

abstract.en: Feel your voice tense like a stretched string when angry
abstract.cn: 体会生气时嗓音如拉紧的琴弦般紧绷

abstract.en: See a room's mood change when the wall color tones down
abstract.cn: 看墙面色调变柔时房间氛围随之改变

examples.en: Please speak in a calm tone.
examples.cn: 请用平静的语气说话。

examples.en: The novelist toned down the violence in the final draft.
examples.cn: 小说家在终稿中淡化了暴力描写。

examples.en: Exercise tones the muscles and lifts the mood.
examples.cn: 锻炼使肌肉紧实，也提振情绪。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「痛」——同样一句「你真棒」，用「痛」的口气说出来就是嘲讽；记住 tone 就是声音里的态度。

root: 希腊语 tonos（拉伸、张力）→ 拉丁语 tonus（音）→ 古法语 ton → 英语 tone。与词根 ten-（拉）同族，extend、tension、tendon 均为亲戚。

sensesIntro.en: From the pitch of one sound to the attitude in a voice, then to color, mood, and body strength.
sensesIntro.cn: 从单个乐音的音高，到嗓音中的态度，再扩展到色彩、基调与身体状态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stretched string giving off colored sound
core.cn: 核心意象：拉紧的弦发出带着颜色的声音

branches.en: the raw quality of one sound
branches.cn: 单个声音的原始质感
从嗓音中流露的态度

branches.en: sound's tone borrowed by color and style
branches.cn: 声音的 tone 被色彩与风格借用

branches.en: the body as an instrument in tune
branches.cn: 身体如调好的乐器：紧实有度
调节强度：使柔和或使结实

intro.en: Tone travels with the Greek root ton- (stretch) and builds a family of pitch and tension words.
intro.cn: tone 携希腊词根 ton-（拉伸）构成一个音高与张力词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin tonus gives English several direct relatives from the same Greek source.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tonus 使英语从同一希腊源头获得若干直接同族词。

items.meaning: a male voice between bass and tenor

derivatives.zh: 有……色调的；肌肉紧实的
爽肤水；墨粉
无音调的；呆板的

definition_en: the movable organ inside the mouth, or a language and the ability to speak
core_image: 嘴里灵活的肌肉：既尝味道又吐语言
scene: 爷爷虽然移民多年，但仍用母语讲故事：He still speaks his mother tongue at home.
sceneCN: 这里 tongue 是「母语」（第 2 个义项：一种语言）；句意是他在家仍说母语。

derivatives.zh: 由 tongue 加 -ed 构成，义为「有……舌形的」
由 tongue 加 -less 构成，义为「无舌的；沉默的」

senses.title: The organ in the mouth
senses.definition: the soft movable organ inside the mouth used for tasting and speaking
senses.definitionCN: 口腔内柔软灵活的器官，用于尝味和发音
senses.example: The dog's tongue hung out as it ran.
senses.exampleCN: 狗跑的时候舌头伸在外面。
senses.why: The core image is simply this flexible muscle that every speaker owns.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象就是这块人人都有、灵活自如的肌肉。

senses.title: A language
senses.definition: a language, especially the one a person learns first
senses.definitionCN: 一种语言，尤指一个人最先学会的语言
senses.example: English is a global tongue shared by many nations.
senses.exampleCN: 英语是许多国家共用的全球性语言。
senses.why: Because the tongue produces speech, it came to stand for the whole language.
senses.whyCN: 因为舌头是发音器官，于是用它代指整个语言。

senses.title: The ability to speak
senses.definition: the power of speech, or the way a person talks
senses.definitionCN: 说话的能力，或一个人说话的方式
senses.example: Fear robbed her of her tongue for a moment.
senses.exampleCN: 恐惧让她一时间说不出话来。
senses.why: Losing the organ means losing speech, so tongue also means the gift of talking.
senses.whyCN: 失去舌头便失去言语，于是 tongue 也指说话的本领。

senses.title: Something shaped like a tongue
senses.definition: a long thin piece that looks or moves like a tongue, such as a flame or a shoe part
senses.definitionCN: 形似舌头的细长物，如火苗、鞋舌等
senses.example: Tongues of flame licked the old barn.
senses.exampleCN: 火苗舔舐着旧谷仓。
senses.why: Anything long, soft and flickering recalls the shape of a tongue.
senses.whyCN: 细长、柔软、闪动之物都会让人联想到舌头的形状。

intro.en: Tongue is an Old English word from the Germanic family, related to Latin lingua only at the deep Indo-European level.
intro.cn: tongue 源自古英语日耳曼语族，与拉丁语 lingua 仅在印欧语系的深层有亲缘。

items.en: The reconstructed root *dn̥ghwā- meant 'tongue', giving both Germanic and Latin words.
items.cn: 重构词根 *dn̥ghwā- 意为「舌头」，同时衍生出日耳曼与拉丁两支词。

items.en: Tunge meant the tongue and, by extension, speech and language.
items.cn: 古英语 tunge 指舌头，引申为言语、语言。

items.en: Spelling varied as tunge, tonge, and tonge with a g before n.
items.cn: 中古英语拼作 tunge、tonge 等，出现 g 在 n 前的写法。

items.en: Spelling settled as tongue, though the g is not pronounced.
items.cn: 拼写定型为 tongue，其中 g 不发音。

items.en: The senses of language and speaking ability remain in daily use.
items.cn: 「语言」与「说话能力」两义沿用至今。

note.en: Words close to tongue in spelling, and words in the mouth-and-language field.
note.cn: 与 tongue 拼写相近的词，以及同属口腔与语言义场的词。

entries.definition: having a tongue of a specified kind
entries.definitionCN: 有……舌的；带舌状的，由 tongue 加后缀构成
吨，发音与 tongue 的首音节相同，词源无关
音调；语气，拼写与发音均近，但词源完全不同
探戈舞，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a system of words used for communication
entries.definitionCN: 语言，与 tongue 的第 2 义同指

entries.definition: the ability to speak or a spoken talk
entries.definitionCN: 说话能力；演讲，与 tongue 的第 3 义相通

entries.definition: a shared language between different groups
entries.definitionCN: 通用语，拉丁语 lingua 与 tongue 在深层同源

entries.definition: a regional form of a language
entries.definitionCN: 方言；地方话，语言的地域变体

normalIntro.en: Fix the silent g, the mother-tongue phrase, and the shape idea.
normalIntro.cn: 记住不发音的 g、母语搭配和形状联想。

normal.en: the g in tongue is silent
normal.cn: tongue 中的 g 不发音，读作 /tʌŋ/

normal.en: mother tongue = your first language
normal.cn: mother tongue（母语）是最常用搭配

normal.en: slip of the tongue = a small mistake in speaking
normal.cn: slip of the tongue（口误）指说错话

normal.en: bite your tongue = stop yourself from speaking
normal.cn: bite your tongue（忍住不说）画面感极强

normal.en: tongues of flame = flickering shapes like a tongue
normal.cn: tongues of flame（火苗）取舌头形状之意

abstract.en: Feel the tongue tap the roof of the mouth for the final sound
abstract.cn: 发音时体会舌头顶上颚，拼写与发音同步入心

abstract.en: Picture a red tongue waving like a small flame
abstract.cn: 想象红色舌头如小火苗般摆动

abstract.en: See two hands biting a tongue to keep a secret
abstract.cn: 想象两只手按住舌头替你保密

examples.en: She bit her tongue to avoid an argument.
examples.cn: 她忍住没说，避免了一场争吵。

examples.en: He speaks three tongues fluently.
examples.cn: 他能流利地讲三种语言。

examples.en: Tongues of fire rose from the campfire.
examples.cn: 火苗从篝火中升腾而起。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「烫」——舌头最怕烫；tongue 的发音里藏着「烫」的提示：舌头管味觉，先想到烫。

root: 古英语 tunge（舌头），出自日耳曼语族；印欧重构词根 *dn̥ghwā-（舌）同时衍生拉丁语 lingua、dingua（舌，语言），故 tongue 与 language 在最深层同源。

sensesIntro.en: One muscle gives taste and speech; the word then names languages and the gift of talking.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一块肌肉负责尝味与说话，这个词继而指语言与口才，最后借给舌状之物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the flexible red muscle that speaks
core.cn: 核心意象：那块会说话的灵活红肌

branches.en: the physical organ for taste and sound
branches.cn: 尝味与发音的实体器官

branches.en: the whole language behind the organ
branches.cn: 由器官引申出的整个语言

branches.en: the power to speak, kept or lost
branches.cn: 可言与失语：说话能力的得失

branches.en: from mother tongue to sharp tongue
branches.cn: 从母语到利嘴：语言与口才并立

branches.en: flames and straps shaped like the organ
branches.cn: 火苗、鞋舌等借用器官形状之物

intro.en: Tongue is a bare Germanic noun; its family is small and mostly descriptive.
intro.cn: tongue 是不带词缀的日耳曼名词，词族不大，多为描述性派生。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cousin lingua built a large family that parallels tongue in meaning.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语同源词 lingua 构建了一个与 tongue 词义平行的大词族。

items.meaning: having a certain tongue or mouthpart

items.exampleCN: 在全班面前紧张得说不出话

items.meaning: a phrase hard to say quickly

definition_en: during or on the evening and night of the present day
core_image: 今天入夜后的时光：从晚饭到天亮之前
scene: 朋友在电话里相约看球赛：Shall we watch the football match tonight?
sceneCN: 这里 tonight 是「今晚」（第 1 个义项：今天晚上这一时段）；句意是约对方今晚一起看足球赛。

derivatives.zh: 由 tonight 加所有格构成，义为「今晚的；今夜的」
由 tonight 加复数构成，义为「一个个夜晚（文学用法，罕见）」

senses.title: The evening of today
senses.definition: during the evening of the present day
senses.definitionCN: 在今天白昼结束后的傍晚与夜里这段时间
senses.example: There is a free concert tonight in the park.
senses.exampleCN: 今晚公园里有一场免费音乐会。
senses.why: The night after today's daylight is exactly what the compound names.
senses.whyCN: 今天白昼之后的那个夜晚，正是这个复合词所指的时段。

senses.title: The coming night
senses.titleCN: 今夜；夜里就寝前后的时间
senses.definition: the night following today, often for sleeping or late activities
senses.definitionCN: 今天之后的这个夜晚，常与睡眠或夜间活动相关
senses.example: I hardly slept tonight because of the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 因为暴风雨，我今夜几乎没睡。
senses.why: The night is one stretch of time, covering both evening fun and sleeping hours.
senses.whyCN: 夜晚是一个连续时段，既涵盖傍晚活动也涵盖睡眠时间。

intro.en: Tonight is a native compound of to and night, parallel to tomorrow and today.
intro.cn: tonight 是 to 与 night 的本土复合词，与 tomorrow、today 构词平行。

items.en: To niht meant 'on (this) night', with to marking time.
items.cn: 古英语 to niht 意为「在（今）夜」，to 作时间标记。

items.en: Written as to-night, the phrase fused into one adverb.
items.cn: 中古英语写作 to-night，短语逐渐融合为一个副词。

items.en: Spelling finally closed up to tonight in general use.
items.cn: 十八至十九世纪，拼写普遍并合为 tonight。

items.en: Both adverb and noun uses are standard today.
items.cn: 如今副词与名词两种用法都是标准用法。

items.en: The origin is clear; the older two-word spelling still appears in old texts.
items.cn: 词源清楚，旧文献中仍见两词分写的拼法。

note.en: Spelling neighbors and time words related to tonight.
note.cn: 与 tonight 拼写相近的词及相关时间词。

entries.definitionCN: 今晚的，所有格形式
金枪鱼，发音与 tonight 开头相近，词源无关
补药；滋补品，拼写相近但词源不同
今天傍晚，强调傍晚而 tonight 兼指夜里
今天，tonight 特指其中的夜晚
明天，与 tonight 相对的一天起点
午夜，今晚时段中的一个时刻

normalIntro.en: Use the to + night pattern and daily phrases to remember it.
normalIntro.cn: 用 to + night 的构词模式和日常搭配来记忆。

normal.en: to + night = on this night
normal.cn: to + night ＝在这个夜里，即今晚

normal.en: parallel to today and tomorrow
normal.cn: 与 today、tomorrow 构词平行，同一套 to + 时间词

normal.en: tonight's show = the show of this evening
normal.cn: tonight's show（今晚的演出）是海报常用语

normal.en: stay in tonight = not go out this evening
normal.cn: stay in tonight 指今晚不出门

normal.en: no preposition before tonight
normal.cn: tonight 前不加介词，直接说 see you tonight

abstract.en: Picture flipping the calendar's page to its dark side
abstract.cn: 想象把日历翻到漆黑的夜面

abstract.en: Hear the quiet to-night as footsteps into darkness
abstract.cn: 把 to-night 听成步入黑暗的脚步声

abstract.en: Feel the day cooling down into tonight
abstract.cn: 感受白天渐渐冷却成今晚

examples.en: Are you free tonight for dinner?
examples.cn: 你今晚有空一起吃晚饭吗？

examples.en: Tonight's game was postponed by rain.
examples.cn: 今晚的比赛因雨延期了。

examples.en: The stars look brighter tonight than usual.
examples.cn: 今晚的星星看起来比平时亮。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「偷耐特」——想象小偷耐着性子等到夜里才行动；to-night，等的就是今夜。

root: 本土复合词：古英语 to（在）+ niht（夜），构词与 today、tomorrow 完全平行；night 属日耳曼语族常用词。

sensesIntro.en: One compound covers the whole dark half of today, from evening plans to the sleeping night.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个复合词涵盖今天的整个暗半段：从傍晚安排到深夜睡眠。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: today's daylight flipping into darkness
core.cn: 核心意象：今天的日光翻转入黑夜

branches.cn: 下班后的傍晚活动

branches.en: the sleeping hours of this dark stretch
branches.cn: 这段夜里的睡眠时间

branches.en: one unbroken night from dusk to dawn
branches.cn: 从黄昏到黎明的连续一夜
以夜晚为框的失眠体验

branches.en: plans announced for the coming dark hours
branches.cn: 为即将到来的夜段宣布的计划

intro.en: Tonight is a simple compound with no classical affixes inside.
intro.cn: tonight 是简单复合词，不含古典词缀。

latinIntro.en: Being Germanic, tonight has no Latin relatives in its own family.
latinIntro.cn: 作为日耳曼词，tonight 自己的词族里没有拉丁同族词。

definition_en: in addition, or more than is needed or wanted
core_image: 天平倾斜：一边多出别人也有或超出的分量
scene: 妹妹想去游乐园，哥哥刚说要去：I want to go to the park too!
sceneCN: 这里 too 是「也」（第 1 个义项：同样、附加）；句意是妹妹说自己也想去公园。

derivatives.zh: 与 too 仅一字母之差，但属不同词源，义为「工具」
由 tooth 加 -y 构成，义为「露齿的」

senses.title: Also; in addition
senses.definition: in addition to something else that has been mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 除已提到的事物之外，同样也如此
senses.example: She sings, and she plays the piano too.
senses.exampleCN: 她会唱歌，还会弹钢琴。
senses.why: The core image adds another share onto the scale, matching the additive sense.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是在天平上再加一份，正对应「附加、同样」义。

senses.title: More than enough
senses.definition: more than is necessary, suitable, or wanted, often followed by an adjective
senses.definitionCN: 超出必要、合适或期望的程度，常后接形容词
senses.example: The tea is too hot to drink right now.
senses.exampleCN: 这茶太烫，现在没法喝。
senses.why: When the added share pushes past the limit, excess replaces addition.
senses.whyCN: 加上的份额越过界限，「附加」义便转为「过度」义。

intro.en: Too is simply the adverb to, whose spelling split off in the seventeenth century.
intro.cn: too 本身就是副词 to，十七世纪起拼写逐渐分化。

items.en: To served as both preposition 'to' and adverb 'besides, in addition'.
items.cn: 古英语 to 既作介词「到」，也作副词「此外、也」。

items.en: The adverbial use of to for 'also' and 'excessively' was common, spelled to or too.
items.cn: 中古英语中 to 作「也」「太」解，拼作 to 或 too 均有。

items.en: Writers began distinguishing too (also, excessively) from to (direction).
items.cn: 十六至十七世纪，写作者开始区分 too（也、太）与 to（方向）。

items.en: The split became a fixed rule of standard spelling.
items.cn: 这种区分成为标准拼写的固定规则。

items.en: The two words share one origin; only the spelling rule is later.
items.cn: 两词同源，只是拼写规则是后来的分化。

note.en: Nearby spellings and words in the addition-and-excess field.
note.cn: 拼写相近的词以及同属附加与过度义场的词。

entries.definitionCN: 到；向；不定式标记，与 too 完全同源，只是分工不同
二，同音异源，历史上拼写曾与 to 混用
工具，只多一个 l，词源与 too 无关
take 的过去式，拼读音近但无关
也；此外，与 too 的附加义同指，位置更灵活
同样；也，句末用法与 too 相同

entries.definition: to an extreme or unnecessary degree
entries.definitionCN: 过度地，与 too 的过度义同指而更正式
过于；太，与 too 同义而书面化

normalIntro.en: Remember the shared spelling story and the two jobs of too.
normalIntro.cn: 记住与 to 的拼写渊源，以及 too 的两个功能。

normal.en: too has one more o than to
normal.cn: too 比 to 多一个 o：多出的 o 正像「也、多」的含义

normal.en: me too = I agree or I also
normal.cn: me too（我也是）是最常用的口语应答

normal.en: too ... to = so much that something cannot happen
normal.cn: too ... to 结构表「太……而不能」

normal.en: too many for countable, too much for uncountable
normal.cn: 可数名词用 too many，不可数用 too much

normal.en: never write to for too in exams
normal.cn: 考试中切勿把 too 误写成 to

abstract.en: See the extra o hop onto the scale and tip it
abstract.cn: 看那个多出来的 o 跳上天平，把秤压斜

abstract.en: Hear a friend echo your sentence with one added word
abstract.cn: 听朋友用多出的一个词应和你的话，即是「也」

abstract.en: Feel soup growing too salty spoonful by spoonful
abstract.cn: 体会汤一勺一勺变得「太」咸的过程

examples.en: I was too tired to walk any farther.
examples.cn: 我太累了，走不动了。

examples.en: He drives too fast on the highway.
examples.cn: 他在高速上开车太快。

examples.en: You know the answer, and I do too.
examples.cn: 你知道答案，我也知道。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吐」——吃「吐」了就是吃太多；too 后接形容词多表示「太、过于」，画面直接对应过度义。

root: 与介词 to 同源：古英语 to 兼作介词与副词；十七世纪后拼写分化，too 专表「也」「太」。属日耳曼本土功能词。

sensesIntro.en: One small adverb does two jobs: adding a share, and marking when a share becomes excess.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个小小的副词承担两职：表示再加一份，也标记加过了头。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one extra share tipping the scale
core.cn: 核心意象：多出的一份把天平压斜

branches.cn: 把另一人或另一物加入同一情形
从足够跨入过度：超过界限
因过度而使行动受阻（too ... to）
口语中的随声附和

branches.en: same word, opposite feelings: welcome addition vs unwanted excess
branches.cn: 同词两情：受欢迎的「也」与不受欢迎的「太」

intro.en: Too is a bare adverb with no affixes; its family is the family of to.
intro.cn: too 是不带词缀的副词，它的词族就是 to 的词族。

latinIntro.en: As a native function word, too has no Latin relatives.
latinIntro.cn: 作为本土功能词，too 没有拉丁同族词。

items.meaningCN: 牙齿，与 too 拼音开头相同，词源无关
工具，与 too 仅一字母之差，词源无关

definition_en: an instrument used for work, or a means of achieving something
core_image: 手里握着的帮手：延伸的手，把力气变成效果
scene: 木匠在工坊里挑选设备：A good carpenter never blames his tools.
sceneCN: 这里 tool 是「工具」（第 1 个义项：干活用的器具）；句意是好木匠从不抱怨自己的工具。

derivatives.zh: 由 tool 与 box 复合构成，义为「工具箱；一套办法」
由 tool 与 maker 复合构成，义为「工具制造者」

senses.title: A hand instrument for work
senses.definition: a device held in the hand and used to carry out a piece of work
senses.definitionCN: 用手持握、用于完成某项工作的器具
senses.example: He fixed the chair with a few simple tools.
senses.exampleCN: 他用几件简单的工具修好了椅子。
senses.why: The core image is the hand extended by an object that turns effort into result.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象就是被物件延伸的手，把力气转化为效果。

senses.title: A means to an end
senses.definition: something that helps you achieve a goal, such as language or software
senses.definitionCN: 帮助达成目标的东西，如语言、软件等
senses.example: English is a powerful tool for international business.
senses.exampleCN: 英语是国际商务的有力工具。
senses.why: Whatever converts effort into results works like a physical tool.
senses.whyCN: 凡能把努力转化为成果的东西，都像实体工具一样发挥作用。

senses.title: A person used by others

intro.en: Tool is an Old English word of the Germanic family, related to the verb 'to make'.

definition_en: one of the hard white objects in the mouth, or a tooth-like part of a thing

senses.title: A hard object in the mouth
senses.definition: one of the hard white structures in the jaw used for biting and chewing
senses.definitionCN: 颌部用于咬切与咀嚼的坚硬白色构造
senses.example: The baby is cutting its first tooth.
senses.exampleCN: 宝宝正在长第一颗牙。
senses.why: The core image is the row of white stones that bite first.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象正是那排先出发咬碎食物的白色小石子。

senses.title: A tooth-like part
senses.definition: a pointed or projecting part resembling a tooth, on combs, gears, or saws
senses.definitionCN: 梳子、齿轮、锯子上形似牙齿的尖突部分
senses.example: One tooth of the gear was broken.
senses.exampleCN: 齿轮上断了一个齿。
senses.why: Machines bite too, so their biting edges are called teeth.
senses.whyCN: 机器也会「咬合」，于是其咬合的尖突被称为齿。

senses.title: Taste or appetite
senses.definition: a liking or appetite for a particular kind of food, especially sweets

senses.exampleCN: 我女儿爱吃甜食。
senses.why: Teeth meet food first, so the word stands for taste preferences.
senses.whyCN: 牙齿最先接触食物，于是这个词代指口味偏好。

senses.title: Effective force
senses.definition: the power of a law or organization to be enforced or to act strongly
senses.definitionCN: 法律或组织得以执行、发挥强力的效力
senses.example: The new regulation has real teeth.
senses.exampleCN: 新规有真正的约束力。
senses.why: Having teeth means being able to bite, hence real power to enforce.
senses.whyCN: 「有牙齿」即能咬人，引申为具有真实的执行力。

intro.en: Tooth is an ancient Indo-European word, sharing one root with Latin dens and Greek odous.
intro.cn: tooth 是古老的印欧词，与拉丁语 dens、希腊语 odous 共享同一词根。

items.en: The reconstructed root *h₃dónts meant 'biting, tooth', from the verb 'to bite'.
items.cn: 重构词根 *h₃dónts 意为「咬的、牙齿」，出自动词「咬」。

items.en: It became *tanthus, preserving the dental root sound.
items.cn: 在日耳曼语中变为 *tanthus，保留了齿音词根。

items.en: Tōth meant tooth; the plural tēth shows the old sound change.
items.cn: 古英语 tōth 指牙齿，复数 tēth 体现了古老的元音变化。

items.en: Spelling stabilized as tooth and teeth with the long oo sound.
items.cn: 中古英语拼写定型为 tooth 与 teeth，保留长元音。

items.en: Figurative senses of taste and enforcement developed.
items.cn: 「嗜好」与「实效」的比喻义发展成形。

note.en: Spelling neighbors of tooth and words of the biting family.
note.cn: 与 tooth 拼写相近的词及「咬」义词族的词。

scene: 登山队员终于站上峰顶大喊：We finally reached the top of the mountain!

senses.title: The highest part
senses.definition: the highest part or upper surface of something

senses.exampleCN: 冰箱顶上积满了灰。

senses.whyCN: 「最高处」的核心意象就是这个最直接的字面义。

senses.title: The highest rank
senses.definition: the highest position, level, or rank in a group or system
senses.definitionCN: 群体或体系中的最高位置、级别或排名
senses.example: She worked her way to the top of the company.
senses.exampleCN: 她一路晋升到公司的最高层。
senses.why: Just as objects have tops, hierarchies have their highest point.
senses.whyCN: 物体有顶端，层级体系同样有其最高点，两义自然贯通。

senses.title: A garment for the upper body
senses.definition: a piece of clothing worn on the upper part of the body
senses.definitionCN: 穿在身体上部的衣服

senses.title: To be at the top of or exceed

items.en: Aristotle's Topika discussed 'places' from which arguments could be drawn.

items.en: Topicus meant 'of a place', used for headings of argument.

definition_zh: 总数的；全部的；完全的；总计
definition_en: complete, or the whole amount reached by adding things together
core_image: 账本最后一行的合计：所有数字归拢成的一个数
scene: 收银员打好小票递给顾客：The total comes to ninety-eight yuan.
sceneCN: 这里 total 是「总计」（第 1 个义项：合计金额）；句意是收银员报出合计九十八元。

senses.title: The whole amount
senses.definition: the complete amount obtained by adding several numbers or quantities together
senses.definitionCN: 把若干数字或数量相加后得到的全部数额
senses.example: Add up the bill and tell me the total.
senses.exampleCN: 把账单加起来，告诉我总数。
senses.why: The core image is the final line where every figure settles together.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象正是账本最后一行——所有数字归拢之地。

senses.title: Complete in amount
senses.definition: considered as a whole; counting everything
senses.definitionCN: 从整体来看的；把一切都计算在内的
senses.example: The total cost of the trip surprised us.
senses.exampleCN: 这次旅行的总花费让我们吃惊。
senses.why: The settled sum becomes a label for anything that includes every part.
senses.whyCN: 合计的结果成为形容「包含全部」的标签。

senses.title: Absolute in degree
senses.definition: complete in degree, with nothing partial about it
senses.definitionCN: 程度上完全的，没有任何不彻底之处
senses.example: The room fell into total silence.
senses.exampleCN: 房间陷入了绝对的寂静。
senses.why: Nothing left outside the sum, so nothing partial remains.
senses.whyCN: 总和之外再无一物，于是不含任何「部分」。

senses.title: To add up to or reach
senses.definition: to reach a particular amount when added together
senses.definitionCN: 相加后达到某一数额
senses.example: The damages totalled two million dollars.
senses.exampleCN: 损失总计达两百万美元。
senses.why: The noun's line of settlement turns into the act of settling.
senses.whyCN: 名词的「结算行」转为动词的「结算」动作。

intro.en: Total goes back to Latin totalis, 'of the whole', from totus meaning 'all, whole'.
intro.cn: total 可追溯到拉丁语 totalis（整体的），出自 totus（全部、整体）。

items.en: The root *teuta- or related forms referred to a people or a whole mass; the connection is uncertain.
items.cn: 相关词根或指人群或整体，关联存疑。

items.en: Totus meant 'all, whole'; totalis was its adjective of belonging.
items.cn: 拉丁语 totus 意为「全部、整体」；totalis 是其所属形容词。

items.en: Totalis appeared in bookkeeping for sums of accounts.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语中 totalis 用于簿记的合计。

items.en: Total passed through French with the accounting sense.
items.cn: total 经法语带着记账义传入。

senses.title: Completely; in every way

senses.title: Absolutely in speech

definition_zh: 触摸；接触；感动；联系；触觉
definition_en: to put a hand or another part of the body on something, or the sense of feeling
core_image: 指尖轻轻落在表面：最小的接触改变最大
scene: 婴儿第一次握住母亲的手指，母亲轻声说：Don't be afraid to touch my hand, little one.
sceneCN: 这里 touch 是「触摸」（第 1 个义项：用手接触）；句意是母亲鼓励孩子触碰自己的手。

collocations.zh: 不联系的；不了解情况的

senses.title: To put a hand on something
senses.definition: to put a finger, hand, or other body part against something
senses.definitionCN: 把手指、手或身体其他部位贴到某物上
senses.example: Do not touch the wet paint.
senses.exampleCN: 不要碰未干的油漆。
senses.why: The core image is the fingertip making the smallest possible contact.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是指尖做出的最轻微接触。

senses.title: To make someone feel emotion
senses.definition: to cause someone to feel pity, gratitude, or other deep feelings
senses.definitionCN: 使人产生怜悯、感激等深切情感
senses.example: Her story touched everyone in the room.
senses.exampleCN: 她的故事感动了在场的每一个人。
senses.why: Emotion was imagined as a contact deep inside the heart.
senses.whyCN: 情感被想象成深入内心的接触，故「触及」即「感动」。

senses.title: The sense of feeling
senses.definition: the ability to feel things through the skin
senses.definitionCN: 通过皮肤感知事物的能力
senses.example: Blind people often have a delicate sense of touch.
senses.exampleCN: 盲人的触觉往往很灵敏。
senses.why: The act of contact names the channel that carries it.
senses.whyCN: 接触的动作转指传递接触的感官通道。

senses.title: A small amount
senses.definition: a slight amount or trace of something
senses.definitionCN: 某物的少量或一丝痕迹
senses.example: Add a touch of salt to the soup.
senses.exampleCN: 往汤里加一点儿盐。
senses.why: The lightest contact leaves the smallest trace.
senses.whyCN: 最轻的接触留下最少的痕迹，故引申为「少许」。

senses.title: Communication or connection
senses.definition: communication with someone, or a connection between people
senses.definitionCN: 与某人的通讯往来或人与人之间的联系
senses.example: Let's keep in touch after graduation.
senses.exampleCN: 毕业后我们保持联系。
senses.why: Being in contact physically became being in contact by message.
senses.whyCN: 身体的接触引申为消息上的往来。

intro.en: Touch came through Old French tochier, probably imitative or from Vulgar Latin *toccare.
intro.cn: touch 经古法语 tochier 而来，一般认为源自通俗拉丁语 *toccare，或为拟声词。

items.en: *Toccare, of uncertain deeper origin, meant 'to strike'.
items.cn: 通俗拉丁语 *toccare 意为「击、碰」，更深的来源不确定。

items.en: Tochier meant 'to touch, hit lightly'.
items.cn: 古法语 tochier 意为「触碰、轻击」。

items.en: Touch entered English for physical contact.
items.cn: 十三世纪 touch 进入英语，指身体接触。

senses.whyCN: 抗拒身体之物同样抗拒计划与情绪，故引申为「艰难」。

intro.en: Tough is an Old English word from the Germanic family, originally describing oxhide-like durability.
intro.cn: tough 是古英语日耳曼词，最初形容如牛皮般耐用之物。

items.en: The root *denk- meant 'to chew', linking toughness with chewing resistance.
items.cn: 词根 *denk- 意为「咀嚼」，把「韧」与嚼不动相连。

items.en: *Tanhuzaz described things hard to chew or break.
items.cn: 日耳曼重构形 *tanhuzaz 形容难嚼难折之物。

items.en: Tōh meant tough, tenacious, or sticky.
items.cn: 古英语 tōh 意为坚韧、粘韧。

items.en: Spelling settled as tough; the sense widened to difficulty and severity.
items.cn: 中古英语拼写定型为 tough，词义扩展到艰难与严厉。

items.en: All four senses stay in active use today.
items.cn: 四个义项沿用至今。

sensesIntro.en: The person who walks tour's circle, counted by the industry that serves the circle.

照片与纪念品作为环线的证据

branches.en: seasons that swell and empty the loop
branches.cn: 让环线胀缩的淡旺季

latinIntro.cn: 词根是经法语 tour 传来的拉丁语 tornus。

definition_en: in the direction of, or close to a point in time or amount
core_image: 箭头指向目标：方向感藏在每一步里
scene: 小猫朝着窗边阳光慢慢走去：The cat walked slowly towards the sunny window.
sceneCN: 这里 toward 是「朝向」（第 1 个义项：表示方向）；句意是小猫慢慢走向洒满阳光的窗户。

derivatives.zh: 由 home 加 -ward 构成，与 toward 同用 -ward 方向后缀，义为「向家的；归途的」
由 fore 加 -ward 构成，同用方向后缀 -ward，义为「向前」
由 up 加 -ward 构成，同用方向后缀 -ward，义为「向上」

senses.title: In the direction of
senses.definition: in the direction that leads to a place or person
senses.definitionCN: 朝向某个地点或人物的方向
senses.example: She walked towards the station.
senses.exampleCN: 她朝车站走去。
senses.why: The core image of an arrow fixed on a target is the pure directional sense.
senses.whyCN: 箭头锁定目标的核心意象，就是最纯粹的方位义。

senses.title: With regard to
senses.definition: showing a feeling or attitude directed at someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 表示针对某人某物的情感或态度
senses.example: His attitude towards the new plan is positive.
senses.exampleCN: 他对新计划持积极态度。
senses.why: Direction in space turns into direction of feeling.
senses.whyCN: 空间的方向转为情感指向的方向。

senses.title: Close to in time or amount
senses.definition: approaching a particular time, age, or amount
senses.definitionCN: 临近某个时间、年龄或数量
senses.example: He is getting richer towards fifty.
senses.exampleCN: 快到五十岁时他越来越富有。
senses.why: Movement toward a point also applies to points in time.
senses.whyCN: 朝某点的移动同样适用于时间轴上的点。

senses.title: Contributing to
senses.titleCN: 有助于；用于（目标或款项）
senses.definition: contributing money or effort to a purpose or fund
senses.definitionCN: 为某目标或款项出资出力
senses.example: They saved money towards a new car.
senses.exampleCN: 他们攒钱准备买辆新车。
senses.why: Effort travels toward a goal just as a body travels toward a place.
senses.whyCN: 努力朝目标移动，正如身体朝地点移动。

intro.en: Toward is Old English to + weard, 'turned to', a compound of facing and direction.
intro.cn: toward 由古英语 to + weard（转向）构成，是「面向」与「方向」的复合词。

items.en: *Warthuza meant 'turning toward, facing'.
items.cn: 日耳曼重构形 *warthuza 意为「转向、面对」。

items.en: To weard meant 'in the direction of', written as two words.
items.cn: 古英语 to weard 意为「朝……方向」，写作两词。

items.en: Toward and towards both appear, meanings identical.
items.cn: 中古英语 toward 与 towards 并存，意义相同。

items.en: American English prefers toward; British English prefers towards.
items.cn: 美式英语偏好 toward，英式偏好 towards。

items.en: The -ward element also lives in forward, backward, homeward.
items.cn: -ward 成分也见于 forward、backward、homeward。

note.en: Words close to toward in form, and direction words of the same family.
note.cn: 与 toward 形近的词及同词族的方向词。

奖项，拼写近似而词源不同（源自拉丁 ad + wardare）

进入，强调进入内部
反对；逆着，态度方向与 toward 相反
远离，方向与 toward 相反

normalIntro.en: Keep the arrow picture and the -ward family together.
normalIntro.cn: 把箭头画面和 -ward 词族绑在一起记。

normal.cn: toward ＝ to（向）+ ward（转），面向目标

normal.en: -ward words: forward, backward, homeward
normal.cn: -ward 词族：forward（向前）、backward（向后）、homeward（归家方向）

normal.en: toward evening = near evening
normal.cn: toward evening 指临近傍晚，方向用于时间

normal.en: money toward a goal = saving for it
normal.cn: money toward a goal 指为目标攒的钱

normal.en: US spelling toward, UK spelling towards
normal.cn: 美式拼 toward，英式拼 towards

abstract.en: See an arrow never quite landing
abstract.cn: 看一支永远差一步未落地的箭，正是「朝向」

abstract.en: Feel feelings flowing like currents toward someone
abstract.cn: 感受情感如水流般流向某人

abstract.en: Watch a calendar page flip closer to the marked date
abstract.cn: 看日历一页页翻近标记的日期

examples.en: The ship headed towards the open sea.
examples.cn: 船朝开阔的大海驶去。

examples.en: Public anger towards the policy kept growing.
examples.cn: 公众对该政策的不满持续增长。

examples.en: Every dollar goes towards rebuilding the school.
examples.cn: 每一美元都用于重建学校。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「特沃德」——特别向我方（ward 有「守卫」联想）靠近：特沃德，正朝我来。

root: 古英语 to（向）+ weard（转向、面向，日耳曼语族），本义「朝向某面」。-ward 后缀的亲戚遍布方向词：forward、backward、upward 等皆同源。

sensesIntro.en: One facing compound points arrows, feelings, dates, and savings at their targets.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个「面向」复合词，把箭头、情感、日期与存款都指向各自目标。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an arrow pointed but not yet landed
core.cn: 核心意象：指向目标却尚未落地的箭

branches.cn: 在空间中移动的身体

intro.en: Toward lives in the productive -ward family of native direction words.
intro.cn: toward 属于能产的 -ward 本土方向词族。

latinIntro.en: Being Germanic, toward has no Latin relatives.
latinIntro.cn: 作为日耳曼词，toward 没有拉丁同族词。

definition_en: a piece of cloth or paper used for drying things or the body
core_image: 吸饱水的布：把湿气统统抱进怀里
scene: 刚出泳池的哥哥把浴巾递给弟弟：Dry yourself with this towel before you catch a cold.
sceneCN: 这里 towel 是「浴巾」（第 1 个义项：擦干用的织物）；句意是哥哥让弟弟擦干身体以免感冒。

derivatives.zh: 由 towel 加 -ing 构成，义为「毛巾布料；擦拭动作」
含 towel 的习语，义为「认输；放弃」，源自拳击投毛巾示意认输

senses.title: A cloth for drying
senses.definition: a piece of absorbent cloth used to dry the body or objects
senses.definitionCN: 用于擦干身体或物品的吸水织物
senses.example: Hang the wet towel on the rack.
senses.exampleCN: 把湿毛巾挂在架子上。
senses.why: The core image is cloth that drinks water into its fibers.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象就是把水分「喝」进纤维里的布。

senses.title: Paper for wiping
senses.definition: a sheet of absorbent paper used once for wiping
senses.definitionCN: 一次性使用的吸水纸片
senses.example: Grab a paper towel for the spill.
senses.exampleCN: 拿张纸巾擦掉洒出的液体。
senses.why: The drying cloth found a cheaper paper twin.
senses.whyCN: 擦干布找到了更便宜的纸替身。

senses.title: To dry with a towel
senses.definition: to dry something using a towel
senses.definitionCN: 用毛巾使某物变干
senses.example: She toweled her hair dry.
senses.exampleCN: 她用毛巾把头发擦干。
senses.why: The tool's action names the verb.
senses.whyCN: 工具的动作转为动词。

intro.en: Towel comes through Old French touaille from a Germanic root for washing cloth.
intro.cn: towel 经古法语 touaille 而来，词根为日耳曼语中指洗擦布的词。

items.en: *Thwahila is reconstructed from a root meaning 'to wash'.
items.cn: 重构形 *thwahila 出自意为「洗」的词根。

items.en: Touaille meant a wiping cloth, borrowed from Germanic speech.
items.cn: 古法语 touaille 指擦布，借自日耳曼语。

items.en: Towel entered English for household drying cloth.
items.cn: 十三至十四世纪 towel 进入英语，指家用擦干布。

items.en: Paper towels extended the word to disposable wiping.
items.cn: 二十世纪纸巾使该词延伸到一次性擦拭。

items.en: The boxing phrase throw in the towel is twentieth century.
items.cn: 拳击短语 throw in the towel（认输）出现于二十世纪。

note.en: Words close to towel in form, and drying items of the household.
note.cn: 与 towel 形近的词及家用擦拭用品。

normal.cn: towel rack（毛巾架）晾挂干毛巾

abstract.cn: 看布吸饱水后沉甸甸鼓起

abstract.en: Hear a boxer's towel hit the ring floor
abstract.cn: 听拳击手的毛巾拍在拳台地上——认输

abstract.en: Feel wet hair squeezed dry by soft loops
abstract.cn: 感受湿发被柔软的毛巾圈圈擦干

examples.cn: 每位客人都有干净的毛巾。

examples.cn: 游泳后他用毛巾擦干了身体。

examples.en: The team refused to throw in the towel.
examples.cn: 这支队伍拒绝认输。

sensesIntro.en: A washing-cloth word that expanded from bath to kitchen to gym.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个「洗擦布」词，从浴室扩展到厨房与健身房。

definition_en: a tall narrow building or structure, or to rise high above things
core_image: 直插云霄的立柱：把人的目光引向高处
scene: 游客仰头看高塔出神：Look at that ancient tower reaching into the clouds!
sceneCN: 这里 tower 是「塔」（第 1 个义项：高耸建筑）；句意是游客仰望直入云霄的古塔。

derivatives.zh: 由 tower 加 -ing 构成，义为「高耸的；激烈的（情绪）」
tower 的复数形式，义为「诸塔；塔楼群」

senses.title: A tall building
senses.definition: a tall narrow structure, often standing alone or part of a building
senses.definitionCN: 高而窄的结构，常独立或为建筑的一部分
senses.example: The church tower dominates the village skyline.
senses.exampleCN: 教堂塔楼主导着村庄的天际线。
senses.why: The core image pulls every eye upward along a vertical line.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象沿一条垂直线把视线拉向高处。

senses.title: A high-rise structure
senses.definition: a modern tall building, especially one for offices or homes
senses.definitionCN: 现代高层建筑，尤指写字楼或住宅楼
senses.example: New glass towers keep rising in the business district.
senses.exampleCN: 商务区不断竖起新的玻璃高楼。
senses.why: The old shape became the skyline of modern cities.
senses.whyCN: 古老的塔形化为现代都市的天际线。

senses.title: To rise above
senses.definition: to be much taller or greater than the surroundings
senses.definitionCN: 比周围高得多、强得多
senses.example: The mountain towers over the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 群山高耸于山谷之上。
senses.why: Height of stone becomes height of comparison.
senses.whyCN: 石头的「高」转为比较的「高」。

intro.en: Tower comes through French from Latin turris, borrowed from Greek tyrsis.
intro.cn: tower 经法语来自拉丁语 turris，后者借自希腊语 tyrsis。

items.en: Tyrsis meant a fortified tower or watch post.
items.cn: 希腊语 tyrsis 指设防的塔楼或瞭望哨。

items.en: Turris was the standard word for a tall defensive structure.
items.cn: 拉丁语 turris 是高耸防御建筑的通称。

items.en: Tur passed into French with the same meaning.
items.cn: tur 进入法语，意义不变。

items.en: Tower settled in English for castles and churches.
items.cn: 十二世纪 tower 在英语中定型，用于城堡与教堂。

items.en: Skyscrapers and radio towers renewed the word's life.
items.cn: 摩天楼与无线电塔让这个词焕发新生。

note.en: Words close to tower in form, and words of the height field.
note.cn: 与 tower 形近的词及同属高度义场的词。

abstract.en: Feel small beneath a stone giant
abstract.cn: 感受自己在石头巨人脚下的渺小

abstract.en: Watch a chess rook standing guard
abstract.cn: 看国际象棋的车（城堡）站岗——塔的原型之一

examples.en: They climbed the tower for the best view.
examples.cn: 他们登上塔顶欣赏最佳视野。

examples.en: She towered over her classmates by ten centimeters.
examples.cn: 她比同学高出十厘米。

examples.en: A towering rage seized him at the news.

definition_en: a settled place larger than a village but smaller than a city
core_image: 一座围着市场与教堂的围墙圈：人们聚拢生活的圈
scene: 姐姐向进城赶集的弟弟介绍：Welcome to our town — the market is just ahead.

senses.title: A settled place
senses.definition: a place with houses, shops, and public buildings, larger than a village
senses.definitionCN: 有房屋、店铺与公共建筑，比村庄大的聚居地
senses.example: They moved to a small town by the lake.
senses.exampleCN: 他们搬到了湖边的一个小镇。
senses.why: The core image is the enclosed circle where people gather to live.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象就是人们聚拢生活的那道围墙圈。

senses.title: The town center
senses.definition: the business and shopping center of the town
senses.definitionCN: 城镇的商业与购物中心
senses.example: I'm heading into town for some shopping.
senses.exampleCN: 我要进城买点东西。
senses.why: The whole place came to mean its busiest circle.
senses.whyCN: 整个地方转指其最热闹的核心圈。

senses.title: The people of the town
senses.definition: all the people who live in a town, treated as one group
senses.definitionCN: 住在镇上的所有人，视为一个整体
senses.example: The whole town came to watch the parade.

intro.en: Town comes from Old English tun, originally an enclosure or farmstead.
intro.cn: town 来自古英语 tun，原指围栏圈地或庄园。

items.en: *Tunaz meant a fence or enclosed plot.
items.cn: 日耳曼重构形 *tunaz 指围栏或圈地。

items.en: Tun meant an enclosure, farm, or cluster of dwellings.
items.cn: 古英语 tun 指圈地、农庄或聚居点。

items.en: Ton and tune shifted to mean a settlement larger than a hamlet.
items.cn: 中古英语 ton、tune 渐指比小村更大的聚落。

items.en: Town fixed its place between village and city.
items.cn: 十四至十六世纪，town 定位于村与市之间。

items.en: Downtown and township extended the family.
items.cn: downtown 与 township 扩展了词族。

note.en: Spelling neighbors of town and the settlement hierarchy.
note.cn: 与 town 拼写相近的词及聚落层级词。

normalIntro.en: Remember the fence origin and the settlement ladder.
normalIntro.cn: 记住「围栏」本义和聚落层级。

normal.en: town first meant a fence, then an enclosure of homes
normal.cn: town 本义是围栏，后来指围起来的家园

normal.en: village < town < city
normal.cn: 聚落层级：村 < 镇 < 市

normal.en: go to town can mean do something with energy
normal.cn: go to town（大干一场）是口语引申用法

normal.en: town hall hosts public meetings
normal.cn: town hall（市政厅）是公共议事之地

normal.en: the whole town = everyone living there
normal.cn: the whole town 指「全镇人」而非建筑物

abstract.en: Draw a circle fence and fill it with homes
abstract.cn: 画一道圈状围栏，再填满房屋

abstract.en: Hear the market bell that gathers the whole circle
abstract.cn: 听集市钟声把整个圈子聚齐

abstract.en: See a ladder of hamlet, village, town, city
abstract.cn: 看小村、村庄、镇、市的阶梯

examples.en: The whole town turned out for the festival.
examples.cn: 全镇的人都来参加节日庆典。

examples.en: This town grew around its railway station.
examples.cn: 这座城镇是围绕火车站发展起来的。

examples.en: Nothing ever happens in our sleepy town.
examples.cn: 我们这个沉睡的小镇从没什么大事发生。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「汤」——镇上人人分一碗热汤：围栏圈里烟火气十足，就是 town。

root: 古英语 tun（围栏、圈地、庄园），日耳曼语族；同源词见于德语 Zaun（栅栏）。本义「圈起来的地」，引申为聚居的镇。

sensesIntro.en: From a fence to a settlement, then to its busy center and its people.
sensesIntro.cn: 从围栏到聚居地，再到热闹的中心与聚居的人们。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fence-circle filled with homes
core.cn: 核心意象：围栏圈成的家园

branches.cn: 介于村与市之间的聚居圈

branches.en: community spirit of a small circle

intro.en: Town builds compounds that map everyday urban life.
intro.cn: town 构成的复合词勾勒出日常城镇生活。

latinIntro.en: As a native Germanic word, town has no Latin relatives.
latinIntro.cn: 作为本土日耳曼词，town 没有拉丁同族词。
